name: Gift of C'Thun applies its authored Shadow damage and healing bonuses natively (#999)
contract: Gift of C'Thun 706189 (Spell.dbc, read for this scenario) is a passive with two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects, target caster. Effect 0 is aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, EffectMiscValue 32 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_SHADOW), BasePoints 3 DieSides 1 (+4) -- matches 'Increases your Shadow damage dealt by 4%'. Effect 1 is aura 136 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_DONE_PERCENT, BasePoints 3 DieSides 1 (+4), no misc filter (this aura applies to all healing by design, matching the tooltip's unqualified 'healing done'). The issue's own DBC evidence ('Effect_132450', 'Mod School Immunity (79)') does not match a direct re-read of Spell.dbc id 706189 with coa-dbc-viewer and is unreliable; aura 79 is in fact SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, not school immunity. Both auras are stock 3.3.5a mechanics read generically wherever damage/healing bonuses are computed (Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone, Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone) -- no per-spell script is needed, and grep confirms zero occurrences of 706189 in src/server/coa or src/server/game, matching only that absence, not a missing mechanic. spell_damage_done/spell_healing_done compute against the actor's live aura state without submitting a cast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Baseline Shadow damage bonus (Eldritch Smite, Shadow school)
Baseline healing bonus (Gaze of C'Thun's heal effect)
Learning the passive applies its own self-aura
Effect 0 carries the authored +4% Shadow damage
Effect 1 carries the authored +4% healing done
CONTRACT: Shadow damage bonus rises by exactly 4% (1000 -> 1040)
CONTRACT: healing bonus rises by exactly 4%
Shadow damage bonus returns to baseline
